demo.prompt: Make the share card for the home page of our skills site. The site's theme file is theme.css (use the dark theme). No generated art: use what the page itself offers.
demo.result:
A 1200×630 card, 83 KB, in the site's own fonts and colours, with its HTML source and the meta tags to add.

![The finished share card](/showcase/og-image-create-after.png)

The logo, headline and context line sit in the middle column. The four badges sit wholly outside the square, and a real screenshot of the page runs off the bottom. The built-in zone check passed.
demo.caption: Real output from an agent with this skill and no other guidance.

before.label: Same request, no skill
before.text:
What a comment thread or a message app shows of the card:

![Square crop of the card made without the skill](/showcase/og-image-create-before-square.png)

The brand is gone and the headline reads "t skills we wrote fo".
before.note: At full width this card looks good: clean, on brand, 67 KB. The fault only shows when a platform crops it to a square.

after.label: With og-image-create
after.text:
The same crop of the card made with the skill:

![Square crop of the card made with the skill](/showcase/og-image-create-after-square.png)

Brand, headline and context line are complete. The badges are dropped whole, as designed.
after.note: The command box loses its side edges in the crop, which the zone rules allow for art.

method: One run each, same request, same model (Claude Fable 5.2) and same tools, November 2026. Both crops are the middle 630 px of the 1200×630 file: the square a Facebook comment was seen to cut a card to, and an estimate for other apps.
